correctness.rationale: Der(A) is eight-dimensional: two generator images each have four coefficients because the square relations differentiate to zero in characteristic 2. The explicit invertible coordinate map Φ to tracezero 3×3 matrices intertwines squares Φ(D²)=Φ(D)². Any nonzero 3×3 square-zero matrix has rank 1 and form uv^T with u,v nonzero and v·u=0. Then D(xy)=v0(u2 x+u1 y+u0 xy), so zero precisely when v0=0. If v0=0 all generator images are in one line (rank_D=1) and H has dimension 2, a surviving unit and square-zero augmentation class, hence dual numbers. If v0≠0, rank_D=2 and H=0. Projective covector v has q+1 points with v0=0 and q² with v0≠0; for each q²−1 eligible nonzero orthogonal vectors u, proving the census. Independently brute-forced all 2^8 derivations on F2, recovering 1,9,12 for ranks 0,1,2. Crucially the original SLOGAN.txt has an actual newline breaking `\(D(xy)\ne0\)` into malformed KaTeX; the complete corrected UTF8 replacement is staged with the exact source Git blob and SHA256.
